meta.description: IDP-035: Ingest Slack /task slash commands with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification (fail-closed), instant ack (<500ms), dynamic project lookup, async Vikunja creation, and response URL direct link.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ title: $json.title, priority: $json.priorityNum, description: 'Created via Slack by @' + $json.userName }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ text: '✅ Task created: *' + $json.title + '*\n👉 <https://tasks.kubelab.live|Open in Vikunja>' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ tag: 'log', title: '📋 Slack Task Captured: ' + $json.title, body: 'Project: #' + $json.project + ' | Priority: ' + $json.priority + ' | By: @' + $json.userName, type: 'info' }) }}
